summary: Completed comprehensive testing of async job pattern implementation (Iteration 2). The critical timeout issue from iteration 1 has been COMPLETELY RESOLVED. Backend async endpoints (/api/generate and /api/assemble) now work perfectly with job polling. Frontend integration with GenerationProgress UI is seamless. All three modes (AI, Form, Hybrid) are fully functional. Library CRUD, validation, and all output tabs working correctly.

minor_issues.note: This appears to be a transient issue. The async endpoint works perfectly and is the primary flow. Sync endpoint is only for fallback/testing.
